# Read data on sensitivity

Read sensitivity data (slopes from Robert).

```{r}
slopes_FlOn <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "slopes_20260302", "Overview_Slopes_all_New_FlOn.csv")) %>%
  select(-...1) %>% mutate(stage = "FlOn")
slopes_SensOn <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "slopes_20260302", "Overview_Slopes_all_SenOn.csv")) %>%
  select(-...1) %>% mutate(stage = "SensOn")
slopes_LeafUnf <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "slopes_20260302", "Overview_Slopes_all_LeafUnf.csv")) %>%
  select(-...1) %>% mutate(stage = "LeafUnf")
slopes_GSL <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "slopes_20260302", "Overview_Slopes_all_GSL.csv")) %>%
  select(-...1) %>% mutate(stage = "GSL")
slopes_FrOn <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "slopes_20260302", "Overview_Slopes_all_New_FrOn.csv")) %>%
  select(-...1) %>% mutate(stage = "FrOn")
slopes_FlDur <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "slopes_20260302", "Overview_Slopes_all_New_FlDur.csv")) %>%

slopes_FlPeak <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "slopes_20260302", "Overview_Slopes_all_New_FlPeak.csv")) %>%

```

## Join and get unique species

```{r}
slopes_all <- bind_rows(slopes_FlOn, slopes_SensOn, slopes_LeafUnf, slopes_GSL,
                        slopes_FrOn, slopes_FlDur, slopes_FlPeak)
```

```{r}
slopes_all_species <- slopes_all %>% distinct(Species)
```

```{r}
nrow(slopes_all_species)
```

## Resolve species names

Resolve species to GBIF accepted names using the package taxize:

```{r}
length(slopes_all_species$Species) # 187
# Due to gna_verifier only being able to handle 50 names at once subsetting
spp1 <- slopes_all_species$Species[1:50]
spp2 <- slopes_all_species$Species[51:100]
spp3 <- slopes_all_species$Species[101:150]
spp4 <- slopes_all_species$Species[151:187]

# Getting current canonical names
resolved_1 <- gna_verifier(spp1, data_sources = 11) # 11 = GBIF Backbone Taxonomy
resolved_2 <- gna_verifier(spp2, data_sources = 11)
resolved_3 <- gna_verifier(spp3, data_sources = 11)
resolved_4 <- gna_verifier(spp4, data_sources = 11)

# Combining all of the names
all_resolved <- rbind(resolved_1, resolved_2, resolved_3, resolved_4)

# Add to sp_list
slopes_all_species_resolved <- slopes_all_species %>%
  cbind(., all_resolved$currentCanonicalFull) %>%
  rename(name_res = `all_resolved$currentCanonicalFull`)
slopes_all_resolved <- slopes_all %>%
  left_join(slopes_all_species_resolved)
```

## Remove one subspecies

```{r}
slopes_all_resolved <- slopes_all_resolved %>%
  mutate(name_res = ifelse(name_res == "Primula vulgaris subsp. vulgaris",
                           "Primula vulgaris", name_res))
```

# Read data on RL spp distribution

Read data on Red List species distribution from Holz et al. 2022.

```{r}
RL <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "Holz_et_al_2022", "rlspecies_distribution.csv")) 
```

# How many PhenObs species in and not in RL?

```{r}
slopes_all_resolved %>% 
  filter(name_res %in% RL$species) %>% 
  distinct(name_res) %>% 
  nrow()
```

```{r}
slopes_all_resolved %>% 
  filter(!name_res %in% RL$species) %>% 
  distinct(name_res) %>% 
  nrow()
```

# Calculate measures of endangerment

Select only spp present in PhenObs data:

```{r}
RL_PhenObs <- RL %>% filter(species %in% slopes_all_resolved$name_res)
nrow(RL_PhenObs %>% distinct(species))
```

How many of these spp are endemic to Europe?

```{r}
RL_PhenObs %>% filter(europe_endemic == 1) %>% distinct(species) %>% nrow()
```

Holz et al. (2022) restricted their analyses to spp endemic to Europe, but we have only one. We can still calculate measures of endangerment, but being aware that these represent only Europe. 

## POWO data for spp in PhenObs not in RL

```{r}
# DOWNLOAD KEW DATA -------------------------------------------------------
download.file(url='https://storage.googleapis.com/kew-dev-backup/world_checklist_names_and_distribution_feb_21.zip',
              destfile='data/raw/KEW.zip')

# unpack
zipF<- "data/raw/KEW.zip"
outDir<-"data/raw"
unzip(zipF,exdir=outDir)
```

```{r}
# read species list
kew_sp <- fread("data/raw/checklist_names.txt")
```

```{r}
PhenObs_not_in_RL <- slopes_all_resolved %>%
  filter(!name_res %in% RL_PhenObs$species) %>% 
  distinct(name_res)
```

```{r}
# join with kew to find accepted plant name id, which is needed to find the species distribution
PhenObs_not_in_RL_kew <- left_join(PhenObs_not_in_RL, 
                                   kew_sp %>% 
                                     select(taxon_name, accepted_plant_name_id,
                                            taxon_rank, taxon_status), 
                                   by = c("name_res"="taxon_name")) 
```

```{r}
update_row <- kew_sp %>%
  filter(taxon_name == "Atropa bella-donna") %>%
  transmute(
    name_res = "Atropa belladonna",
    accepted_plant_name_id,
    taxon_rank,
    taxon_status
  )

PhenObs_not_in_RL_kew <- PhenObs_not_in_RL_kew %>%
  rows_update(update_row, by = "name_res")
```

```{r}
PhenObs_not_in_RL_kew_unique <- PhenObs_not_in_RL_kew %>%
  mutate(
    status_order = case_when(
      taxon_status == "Accepted" ~ 1,
      taxon_status == "Synonym" ~ 2,
      taxon_status == "Illegitimate" ~ 3,
      taxon_status == "Invalid" ~ 4,
      taxon_status == "Misapplied" ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ 99
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(name_res, status_order) %>%
  distinct(name_res, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(-status_order)
```

```{r}
# read distribution data
kew_dis <- fread("data/raw/checklist_distribution.txt")
```

```{r}
# botanical countries e.g. Canary islands / Sicilly / Corse are actually included in the national RL of Spain / Italy / France
kew_dis <- kew_dis %>% 
mutate(botanical_countries_l3 = as.character(area)) %>% 

  mutate(botanical_countries_l3=replace(botanical_countries_l3, botanical_countries_l3=="Corse", "France")) %>% 
  mutate(botanical_countries_l3=replace(botanical_countries_l3, botanical_countries_l3=="Kriti", "Greece")) %>% 
  mutate(botanical_countries_l3=replace(botanical_countries_l3, botanical_countries_l3=="Krym", "Ukraine")) %>% 
  mutate(botanical_countries_l3=replace(botanical_countries_l3, botanical_countries_l3=="East Aegean Is.", "Greece")) %>% 
  
  mutate(botanical_countries_l3=replace(botanical_countries_l3, botanical_countries_l3=="Canary Is.", "Spain")) %>% 
  mutate(botanical_countries_l3=replace(botanical_countries_l3, botanical_countries_l3=="Baleares", "Spain")) %>%
  
  mutate(botanical_countries_l3=replace(botanical_countries_l3, botanical_countries_l3=="Sicilia", "Italy")) %>% 
  mutate(botanical_countries_l3=replace(botanical_countries_l3, botanical_countries_l3=="Sardegna", "Italy"))
```

```{r}
# subset kew dis
noRL_PhenObs <- PhenObs_not_in_RL_kew_unique %>% 
  select(name_res, accepted_plant_name_id) %>% 
  rename(plant_name_id = accepted_plant_name_id) %>% 
  left_join(kew_dis) %>%
  select(name_res, plant_name_id, botanical_countries_l3) %>%
  rename(species = name_res) %>%
  mutate(Threatened = 0)
```

## Merge RL and no RL

```{r}
PhenObs_all <- bind_rows(RL_PhenObs %>% select(-europe_endemic), noRL_PhenObs)
```

## Add data on botanical country area

### Download the WGSRPD Level-3 shapefile from GitHub

```{r}
# Create temporary directory
td <- tempdir()

# Download ZIP of the repository
zipfile <- file.path(td, "wgsrpd.zip")

download.file(
  "https://github.com/tdwg/wgsrpd/archive/refs/heads/master.zip",
  zipfile,
  mode = "wb"
)

# Unzip
unzip(zipfile, exdir = td)

# Locate Level-3 shapefile
shp <- file.path(
  td,
  "wgsrpd-master",
  "level3",
  "level3.shp"
)

# Read polygons
wgsrpd <- st_read(shp, quiet = TRUE)

# Check attribute names
names(wgsrpd)
```

### Calculate areas

```{r}
# Equal-area projection
wgsrpd_ea <- st_transform(wgsrpd, 6933)

# Area in km²
wgsrpd$area_km2 <- as.numeric(st_area(wgsrpd_ea)) / 1e6
```

### Add to PhenObs_all data

```{r}
PhenObs_all_props <- PhenObs_all %>%
  left_join(
    wgsrpd %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      select(LEVEL3_NAM, area_km2),
    by = join_by(botanical_countries_l3 == LEVEL3_NAM)
  ) %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    n_countries = n_distinct(botanical_countries_l3),
    n_countries_threatened = sum(Threatened, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_range_area = sum(area_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
    threatened_range_area = sum(area_km2[Threatened == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    prop_countries_threatened = n_countries_threatened / n_countries,
    prop_range_threatened = threatened_range_area / total_range_area
  )
```

# Merge data on sensitivity and endangerment

```{r}
sens <- slopes_all_resolved %>% 
  # Remove old species names
  select(-Species) %>%
  # Use resolved species as species names
  rename(species = name_res) %>%
  # Add variable for "sens" vs "not-sens"
  mutate(sens_01 = factor(ifelse(ci_lower > 0 | ci_upper < 0, 1, 0))) %>%
  # Remove unneeded cols
  select(-ci_lower, -ci_upper, -n_gardens, -temp_min, -temp_max, -temp_mean,
         -n_data) %>%
  # Reorder
  select(species, stage, sens_01, mean_slope, slope_var)
```

```{r}
sens_endanger <- left_join(sens, PhenObs_all_props)
```

# Correlations

```{r}
sens_endanger %>%
  select(species, stage, mean_slope) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = stage, values_from = mean_slope) %>%
  select(-species) %>% 
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs") %>%
  corrplot(method = "color", type = "upper", tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45,
           addCoef.col = "black")   # optional: show correlation values
sens_endanger %>%
  select(prop_countries_threatened, prop_range_threatened) %>% 
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
```

# Distributions

```{r}
ggplot(sens_endanger, aes(x = prop_countries_threatened)) +
  geom_histogram(color = "black", fill = "grey") +
  labs(x = "Prop. of countries threatened", y = "Number of species") +
  theme_bw()
ggplot(sens_endanger, aes(x = prop_range_threatened)) +
  geom_histogram(color = "black", fill = "grey") +
  labs(x = "Prop. of range threatened", y = "Number of species") +
  theme_bw()
ggplot(sens_endanger, aes(x = factor(sens_01))) +
  geom_bar() +
  facet_wrap(~ stage) +
  labs(x = "Sensitive (0 = No, 1 = Yes)", y = "Number of species") +
  theme_bw()
ggplot(sens_endanger, aes(x = mean_slope)) +
  geom_histogram(color = "black", fill = "grey") +
  facet_wrap(~ stage, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "Sensitivity (mean slope)", y = "Number of species") +
  theme_bw()
```

# Models endangerment ~ sensitivity 

## Sensitive or not

```{r}
stage_names <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50) %>%
  distinct(stage) %>%
  pull(stage)

mod_sens_01_countries <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50) %>%
  group_by(stage) %>%
  group_map(~ glm(cbind(n_countries_threatened,
                         n_countries - n_countries_threatened) ~ sens_01, 
                   data = .x, family = binomial())) %>%
  setNames(stage_names)

mod_sens_01_range <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50) %>%
  group_by(stage) %>%
  group_map(~ glmmTMB(prop_range_threatened ~ sens_01, data = .x, 
                      family = beta_family(), ziformula=~.)) %>%
  setNames(stage_names)

map_df(mod_sens_01_countries, tidy, .id = "stage") %>%
  mutate(sig = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", "")) %>% print(n = 50)
map_df(mod_sens_01_range, tidy, .id = "stage") %>%
  mutate(sig = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", "")) %>% print(n = 50)
```

```{r}
plot(ggpredict(mod_sens_01_countries$FlDur))
plot(ggpredict(mod_sens_01_range$LeafUnf, type = "zi_prob"))
```

## Sensitivity sign

```{r}
sens_endanger <- sens_endanger %>%
  mutate(sens_sign = factor(case_when(
    mean_slope > 0 ~ "positive",
    mean_slope < 0 ~ "negative",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )))
```

```{r}
mod_sens_sign_countries <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50) %>%
  group_by(stage) %>%
  group_map(~ glmmTMB(cbind(n_countries_threatened,
                         n_countries - n_countries_threatened) ~ sens_sign, 
                      data = .x, family = binomial())) %>%
  setNames(stage_names)

mod_sens_sign_range <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50) %>%
  group_by(stage) %>%
  group_map(~ glmmTMB(prop_range_threatened ~ sens_sign, data = .x, 
                      family = beta_family(), ziformula=~.)) %>%
  setNames(stage_names)

map_df(mod_sens_sign_countries, tidy, .id = "stage") %>%
  mutate(sig = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", "")) %>% print(n = 50)
map_df(mod_sens_sign_range, tidy, .id = "stage") %>%
  mutate(sig = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", "")) %>% print(n = 50)
```

```{r}
plot(ggpredict(mod_sens_sign_countries$FlOn))
plot(ggpredict(mod_sens_sign_countries$SensOn))
plot(ggpredict(mod_sens_sign_countries$LeafUnf))
plot(ggpredict(mod_sens_sign_countries$FrOn))
plot(ggpredict(mod_sens_sign_countries$FlDur))
plot(ggpredict(mod_sens_sign_range$FlOn, type = "zi_prob"))
```

## Mean slopes

### FlDur and GSL: all values

```{r}
stage_names_FlDur_GSL <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50) %>%
  filter(stage %in% c("FlDur", "GSL")) %>%
  distinct(stage) %>%
  pull(stage)

mod_sens_countries_all <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50) %>%
  filter(stage %in% c("FlDur", "GSL")) %>%
  group_by(stage) %>%
  group_map(~ glm(cbind(n_countries_threatened,
                         n_countries - n_countries_threatened) ~ mean_slope, 
                  data = .x, family = binomial())) %>%
  setNames(stage_names_FlDur_GSL)
mod_sens_range_all <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50) %>%
  filter(stage %in% c("FlDur", "GSL")) %>%
  group_by(stage) %>%
  group_map(~ glmmTMB(prop_range_threatened ~ mean_slope, data = .x, 
                      family = beta_family(), ziformula=~.)) %>%
  setNames(stage_names_FlDur_GSL)
map_df(mod_sens_countries_all, tidy, .id = "stage") %>%
  mutate(sig = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", "")) %>% print(n = 50)
map_df(mod_sens_range_all, tidy, .id = "stage") %>%
  mutate(sig = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", "")) %>% print(n = 50)
```

```{r}
plot(ggpredict(mod_sens_countries_all$GSL, terms="mean_slope [all]"))
plot(ggpredict(mod_sens_countries_all$FlDur, terms="mean_slope [all]"))
```

### Other stages

#### Negative slopes only

```{r}
stage_names_not_FlDur_GSL <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50) %>%
  filter(!stage %in% c("FlDur", "GSL")) %>%
  distinct(stage) %>%
  pull(stage)

mod_sens_countries_neg <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50 & mean_slope < 0) %>%
  filter(!stage %in% c("FlDur", "GSL")) %>%
  group_by(stage) %>%
  group_map(~ glm(cbind(n_countries_threatened,
                         n_countries - n_countries_threatened) ~ mean_slope, 
                  data = .x, family = binomial())) %>%
  setNames(stage_names_not_FlDur_GSL)
mod_sens_range_neg <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50 & mean_slope < 0) %>%
  filter(!stage %in% c("FlDur", "GSL")) %>%
  group_by(stage) %>%
  group_map(~ glmmTMB(prop_range_threatened ~ mean_slope, data = .x, 
                      family = beta_family(), ziformula=~.)) %>%
  setNames(stage_names_not_FlDur_GSL)
map_df(mod_sens_countries_neg, tidy, .id = "stage") %>%
  mutate(sig = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", "")) %>% print(n = 50)
map_df(mod_sens_range_neg, tidy, .id = "stage") %>%
  mutate(sig = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", "")) %>% print(n = 50)
```

```{r}
plot(ggpredict(mod_sens_countries_neg$SensOn, terms="mean_slope [all]"))
plot(ggpredict(mod_sens_range_neg$SensOn, type = "zi_prob", terms="mean_slope [all]"))
plot(ggpredict(mod_sens_range_neg$SensOn, type = "fixed", terms="mean_slope [all]"))
```
